protocol.name: moazami_world_to_chip_dmf
protocol.method: World-to-chip interfacing with 3D-printed reagent delivery and closed-loop PID TEC temperature control
protocol.reference: Moazami et al., Anal. Chem. 2019, 91, 5159-5168. DOI: 10.1021/acs.analchem.8b05754
protocol.application: Bacterial co-transformation and enzymatic endoglucanase activity assay on DMF

modules.description: Abstracts off-chip colony count QC; proxy for on-chip post-heat-shock cell viability signal
Abstracts CLARIOStar plate reader fluorescence readout; MUF emission at 449 nm, excitation 368 nm

reagents.description: Chemically competent E. coli DH5alpha cells; thawed on ice 10 min before use
Plasmid coding for GFP; kanamycin selection (50 ug/mL); diluted to 1 ug/uL; 100 ng per reaction
Plasmid with RFP insert (BBa_J04450); chloramphenicol selection (35 ug/mL); 100 ng per reaction
CaCl2 stock at 150 mM; final on-chip concentration 75 mM; critical for chemical competence
4-methylumbelliferyl beta-D-cellobioside (MUC); 40 uM stock in 50 mM sodium-phosphate pH 7.0; 0.05% Pluronics F-68 additive
Endoglucanase enzyme; cleaves beta-(1,4) glycosidic bonds in MUC; concentration held constant across all assay conditions; 0.05% Pluronics F-68 additive
0.3 M glycine-NaOH pH 11.0; stops enzymatic activity and enhances MUF fluorescence at alkaline pH
50 mM sodium-phosphate pH 7.0; used for serial dilution of MUC substrate to 20 uM and 10 uM; 0.05% Pluronics F-68 additive
0.05% Pluronics F-68 additive; dissolved in all assay solutions; prevents biofouling and maintains droplet actuation on device surface
reagents.quantity_unit: additive; not dispensed as standalone droplet

world_to_chip_interfaces.description: 3D-printed cylindrical well (8 mm OD, 45 mm height, 1 mm inlet hole; PLA material) mated to ITO top plate; 400 uL bulk reagent capacity; threaded screw delivers fluid to ancillary reservoir on-chip; ancillary reservoir refills main reservoir (7 uL target volume) via impedance-controlled actuation sequence after every dispense; eliminates manual reservoir refilling and improves droplet dispensing reproducibility (RSD reduced from 19.61% to 11.62% for LB media)

20x40 mm thermoelectric cooler (TEC/Peltier module) integrated below DMF chip; aluminum heat block (20x40x5 mm) with RTD sensor; closed-loop PID control implemented in MATLAB/Simulink; PID parameters: Kp=15, Ki=1.2, Kd=0.5; heat-shock zone: 42 C (rise rate 2.1 C/s); cold zone: 4 C (drop rate 1.01 C/s); assay zone: 30 C steady-state; 12V DC cooling fan on heat sink

steps.name: Dispense competent cells
steps.note: E. coli DH5alpha thawed on ice 10 min before use; in ITO-well-DMF configuration, 400 uL bulk cells loaded in 3D-printed well; ancillary reservoir refills main after each dispense

steps.name: Dispense plasmid DNA droplets
steps.note: pFAB4876 (KanR, GFP) and pSB1C3-RFP (CamR) each diluted to 1 ug/uL; 100 ng per plasmid per reaction; co-transformation uses both plasmids simultaneously

steps.name: Dispense CaCl2 solution
steps.note: CaCl2 stock 150 mM; final on-chip concentration 75 mM after merging with cells and DNA in equal volume ratio

steps.name: Merge DNA plasmids
steps.note: Sequential merging is required for DMF; paper summarises as 'equal volume ratio' merge of all four components

steps.name: Add CaCl2 to complete transformation mix
steps.note: Final droplet contains cells, pFAB4876, pSB1C3-RFP, and CaCl2 at 75 mM; all four components in equal 1 uL volume ratio

steps.name: Heat shock Phase 1 -- 42 C for 60 s
steps.note: Closed-loop PID TEC (Kp=15, Ki=1.2, Kd=0.5); rise rate 2.1 C/s; drives transient membrane pore formation for DNA uptake in chemically competent DH5alpha

steps.name: Heat shock Phase 2 -- 4 C for 180 s
steps.note: TEC cools to 4 C at 1.01 C/s; stops membrane disruption and stabilises DNA-cell complex; 180 s = 3 min cold recovery

steps.name: Post-transformation QC detection and branch
steps.note: transformationQC module abstracts off-chip colony count (Kan+Cam agar plate, 37 C overnight); on-chip proxy: post-heat-shock viability signal; expected efficiency with PID+well: ~9.27e4 CFU/ug DNA for co-transformation

steps.name: Dispense 40 uM MUC substrate assay droplet
steps.note: Dispensed first and stored untouched in assay area 1; not consumed by any dilution step; 0.05% Pluronics F-68 in all solutions

steps.name: Prepare 20 uM MUC assay droplet by direct dilution
steps.note: 1 unit 40 uM stock + 1 unit buffer mixed 1:1; (1 unit x 40 uM) / 2 units total = 20 uM; scalar mix, no split needed; avoids compiler split-array stranding bug

steps.name: Prepare 10 uM MUC assay droplet by explicit buffer chaining
steps.note: Target: 1:3 dilution (1 unit 40 uM stock + 3 units buffer = 10 uM). Compiler ignores multi-unit volume scalars (dispense 3 units defaults to 1 unit in IR); three buffer droplets explicitly instantiated and chained before final mix. (1 unit x 40 uM) / 4 units total = 10 uM.

steps.name: Dispense enzyme droplets
steps.note: One unit droplet per assay area; enzyme concentration held constant across all three substrate concentration conditions (paper Fig. 5 caption); in ITO-well-DMF: enzyme reservoir refilled from 3D well after each dispense

steps.name: Start reactions -- merge enzyme with substrate in each assay area
steps.note: Paper M&M: 'all three substrate-containing droplets were simultaneously mixed with the enzyme droplets in the assay areas'; TEC activates for closed-loop 30 C control

steps.name: Incubate at 30 C for 30 min
steps.note: Endoglucanase cleaves beta-(1,4) glycosidic bond in MUC releasing MUF fluorophore; closed-loop PID TEC holds 30 C steady-state; all three reactions run concurrently in separate assay areas

steps.name: Quench reactions
steps.note: Paper M&M: 'a unit droplet of quenching solution (0.3 M glycine-NaOH, pH 11.0) was mixed with each reaction droplet'; 1 unit quench per assay area regardless of substrate droplet volume

steps.name: Fluorescence detection and cleanup
steps.note: CLARIOStar plate reader (off-chip); MUF emission 449 nm, excitation 368 nm; well-scan 15x15 matrix, 6 mm diameter, focal height 4.0 mm, gain 1180; maximum fluorescence per droplet recorded; QC gate keyed on 40 uM signal (highest expected MUF output)
